title: Count the number of set bits
problemStatement: Solve “Count the number of set bits” as posed in the A2Z sheet (Learn Bit Manipulation).
intuition: "Count the number of set bits" uses bits as flags or XOR cancellations. Know shifts, masks, and that Python ints are unbounded (still discuss fixed-width in interviews).

approaches.title: Bit trick / mask approach
approaches.code:
def solve(n: int) -> int:
    # Skeleton for: Count the number of set bits
    # Example idioms:
    # n & 1        -> parity
    # n & (n - 1)  -> drop lowest set bit
    # n & -n       -> isolate lowest set bit
    cnt = 0
    while n:
        n &= n - 1
        cnt += 1
    return cnt
approaches.time: O(#bits) or O(1) with hw instructions
